2872-4613-6858.easyPrerequisites:
Oreskos Sun Guide doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Clever Conjurer is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
2872-4613-6858.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2872-4613-6858.description:
Activate Oreskos Sun Guide using Clever Conjurer's ability by tapping it, untapping another creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the other creature using Clever Conjurer's ability by tapping it, untapping Oreskos Sun Guide
Oreskos Sun Guide triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

1479-3861-8293.description:
Play Orzhov Basilica.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it, Cleveland Booker, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Cleveland Booker trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it and Cleveland Booker trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1170-1329-4708-8201.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Dark Sphere from your graveyard.
Cast Dark Sphere by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

4279-6255-6634--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-6255-6634--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Al Bhed Salvagers, Zahur and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Zahur ability, creating a tapped 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Al Bhed Salvagers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

4050-5170-6132-7574.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Sultai Flayer triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Sultai Flayer trigger.
Resolve the Sultai Flayer trigger, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

2446-3259-7296.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2446-3259-7296.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Living Hive, triggering Breath of Fury and Living Hive.
Resolve the Living Hive trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a type chosen that matches a type of the persist creature

345-6798--5.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Metallic Mimic
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat

997-1445-4871-7422.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
997-1445-4871-7422.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

457-1458-4404-4908.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
457-1458-4404-4908.description:
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {U} due to Enthusiastic Mechanaut.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Banishing Knack.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Banishing Knack by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

1445-1913-4871-5147.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and an artifact creature card in your graveyard.
1445-1913-4871-5147.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Imotekh the Stormlord triggers if the creature that was returned to your hand was an artifact, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1491-2113-2313-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

4067-4306-5181-6281.description:
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}{U}
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Golgari Findbroker.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Golgari Findbroker that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Golgari Findbroker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Golgari Findbroker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Nyx Lotus.
Repeat.

967-3809-5686-6753-7087.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

1170-1329-1482-6965.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard.
Cast Jeweled Lotus by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

997-4053-6972.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature without a -1/-1 counter on it.
997-4053-6972.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another nontoken creature without a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Solemnity.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

2866-3200-4986-5686.description:
Cast Urza's Bauble by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Urza's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

2639-3254-4050-6022.manaNeeded: {4}{G/W}{B}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
2639-3254-4050-6022.description:
Cast Nethroi either from your hand or from the command zone for its mutate cost by paying {4}{G/W}{B}{B}, putting it under a non-Human creature you control.
Nethroi triggers, returning Quickling and Mitotic Slime from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Quickling enters, it triggers, returning Nethroi from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Quickling and Mitotic Slime, adding {B}{B}.
When Mitotic Slime dies, it triggers, creating two 2/2 Ooze creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Oozes, adding {1}{G/W}.
When the Oozes die, they trigger, creating four 1/1 Ooze creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Oozes, adding {3}.
Repeat.
2639-3254-4050-6022.notes: During step 2, you can recur other creatures with suitable powers. This will allow you to forego sacrificing that many Oozes in step 8, netting infinite mana and creature tokens. If you have infinite mana and Oozes, you can then forego reanimating Mitotic Slime and reanimate anything else with a suitable power instead.

2232-5399-6749.easyPrerequisites: You control six or more lands.
2232-5399-6749.description:
Cast Pirated Copy by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Anticausal Vestige.
When Pirated Copy enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Anticausal Vestige from the battlefield to your hand.
When Anticausal Vestige leaves the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and and put Anticausal Vestige from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Anticausal Vestige enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Pirated Copy from the battlefield to your hand.
When Pirated Copy leaves the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Pirated Copy from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Anticausal Vestige.
Repeat from step 2.

5641-6752-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
5641-6752-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-2733-4826-5954-6751.description:
Cast Shimmering Wings by paying {U}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Shimmering Wings spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Shimmering Wings by paying {U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

1339-2122-4050-4435.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw two cards.
The Locust God triggers twice, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens with flying and haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Insects, adding {2}.
Activate Mindless Automaton's first ability twice by paying {2} and discarding two cards, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

628-5315-5490.notablePrerequisites: Pith Driller does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
628-5315-5490.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrifiicing Pith Driller.
When Pith Driller dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Pith Driller enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

2452-3249-3641-5670--56.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast a Zombie from your graveyard this turn.
Cast the Zombie from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Rooftop Storm.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Zombie, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

4786-4808-5751-5774.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two land cards in hand.
4786-4808-5751-5774.description:
Cast Black Lotus by paying {0}.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Cast Black Lotus from your graveyard for its retrace cost by discarding a land card.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Cast Invasion of Shandalar from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {3}{G}{G} and discarding a land card.
When Invasion of Shandalar triggers, it triggers, returning Black Lotus and two land cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Claws of Gix by paying {1} and sacrificing Invasion of Shandalar, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

2584-3059-3231.description:
Cast Malignus by paying {3}{R}{R}.
When Malignus enters the battlefield, Pandemonium triggers, dealing an amount of damage equal to twice Malignus' power to an opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

262-803-4620.notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery attached to Captain of the Mists.
Captain of the Mists does not have summoning sickness.
"Human" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
262-803-4620.description:
Activate Captain of the Mists by tapping it, creating at least two 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste.
When the Elementals enter the battlefield as Humans due to Arcane Adaptation, Captain of the Mists triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

3487-4089-4374.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two energy counters.
3487-4089-4374.description:
Activate Aethergeode Miner by paying {E}{E}, blinking it.
Aethergeode Miner enters the battlefield, triggering Aetherstorm Roc and Glasspool Mimic, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Repeat.

539-1776-2617.notablePrerequisites:
Spawning Grounds attached to Midnight Guard.
Midnight Guard does not have summoning sickness.
539-1776-2617.description:
Activate Midnight Guard by tapping it, creating a 5/5 Beast creature token.
When the Beast enters the battlefield, Midnight Guard triggers, untapping it.
Repeat.

539-1479-1778-2232-3585.description:
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Memnite enters the battlefield, triggering Kodama and Greensleeves.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Greensleeves trigger, creating a 3/3 Badger creature token.
The Badger enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio and Kodama.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return Memnite from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Memnite from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1247-2470.easyPrerequisites: Pili-Pala does not have summoning sickness.
1247-2470.description:
Activate Grand Architect's first activated ability by paying {U}, making Pili-Pala blue until end of turn.
Activate Grand Architect's last ability by tapping Pili-Pala, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to cast artifact spells or activate abilities of artifacts.
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {2} and untapping it, generating {U}.
Repeat from step 2 any number of times.

2605-3930-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Rimewind Taskmage does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Rimewind Taskmage.
You control at least four snow permanents.
2605-3930-4222.description:
Activate Lotus Vale by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Rimewind Taskmage by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Lotus Vale.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Rimewind Taskmage.
Repeat any number of times.
Repeat steps with a different color for infinite mana of any color.

339-677-3152-5256.notablePrerequisites:
Jegantha does not have summoning sickness.
You control another nontoken Elemental creature.
339-677-3152-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing any other nontoken Elemental creature, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that can't be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, casting any Elemental creature from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
The Elemental enters the battlefield, triggering Chakram Retriever, untapping Jegantha.
Repeat.

45-364-813-1987.description:
Activate Khalni Gem by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Khalni Gem and Scholar of the Ages, blinking them.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Khalni Gem enters the battlefield, return two lands you control to your hand if able.
Repeat.
